method: Visual inspection of 29 actual final native Shipping PNGs by the UI and battle reviewers. Each freshly generated image, successful launch metadata and captured state is pinned to its inspected bytes and UTC review time; native executable SHA-256 0f35c7e9f52bb6009876c5e2eef23be8d4033712d844a91f04a8c28c68aa176b. No older or unseen frames reused.

No overlap between hero art, actions or deck summary.

Available collection continues below the fold in the scroll area.
